dataset.onset_convention: Samples 1-160 are the eight-hour normal prefix; sample 161 is the first fault-affected sample. This is an evaluation convention derived from the dataset description, not a per-row annotation.

configuration.selection_rule: Explicit complete simulation IDs, selected before viewing fault results

normalizer.constant_channel_rule: StandardScaler uses scale=1 for constant channels

metrics.latency_definition: first flagged eligible endpoint at/after onset minus onset; means/medians exclude misses
metrics.miss_representation: null latency and detected=false; explicit coverage and right-censoring horizon
